title: What Does Mawlana Shaykh Nazim Say About NurMuhammad.com?
body:
Phone conversation after the Sufilive Broadcast:
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Hisham Effendi? Yessir as-salaamu `alaykum.
Shaykh Hisham: wa `alaykum salaam wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh. How are you Sayyidee?
Ahamdulillah, very good now that I am hearing your words.
Shaykh Hisham: Istaghfirullah your words are what is important. Allah give you long life, MashaaAllah
Mawlana very beautiful suhbah.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: this is because of your baraka, oh Shaykh.
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana it is from the baraka of Zati `aliniz, Allah Raise your more.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Allah Allah, its been a year now this Friday it will be one year 365 suhbat (since I
began) SubhaanAllah.
Shaykh Hisham: Yes Sayyidee. We have printed them for you in books we named Sufilive Series. We called it
Sufilive. I will bring you the books with me. We printed the first 2 books, each book is 200 pages. We have a
total of 15 books. Yes Mawlana.

MashaaAllah, almost 3000 to 4000 pages.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: uh uh uh (very impressed)

Shaykh Hisham: SubhaanAllah Sayyidee. One subhah a day for one year every day MashaaAllah
Sayyidee. We have lots of books to print, we are printing them in English.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Print, print, who will read them me or you (laughing)?
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana SubhaanAllah we have many websites almost 10. People can go to the websites
and read your suhbah. For example we have naqshbandi.org it has almost 50000 pages. We have naqshbandi.
net, people read it. We have Haqqanisoul.com under your name, people read it. We have Sufilive, all your
suhbahs are there. People go there to see them and many enter into Islam. We have NurMuhammad
Sayyidee, this targeting the Americans and the westerners, they read it because it doesn't speak Sufism.
It speaks about culture, and numerology. The website is for the west its called nurMuhammad.com. Lots of
people come through this website to Islam. They become good Muslims, they then come to see you.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: and they become good Muslims.
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana everyday on this website nurMuhammad website 1000 visit to read, and 10 or 15
accept Islam.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Allah Allah
Shaykh Hisham: Its called nurMuhammad website light of Prophet (pbuh)
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Allahu Akbar.
Shaykh Hisham: All these websites are about you Sayyidee About the Naqshbandiyyah Way and the Seal of
Awliya Mawlana Shaykh Nazim Al-Haqqani.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Alhamdulillah from beginning and in the end. First and last Alhamdulillah.
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana, Mawlana we need your blessings for this website, For NurMuhammad website
because they are attacking us a lot (because of it) Sayyidee. Because SubhaanAllah, many people are
visiting it. But they are not able to do anything.
Because SubhaanAllah, many people are visiting it.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Who is that (one attacking you)?
Shaykh Hisham: These are some people Sayyidee always cursing us. Claiming that this website is not
Naqshbandi Tariqat. That it is Buddhist. They claim different sizes and colors (many things).
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: laughing: Hisham Effendi.
Shaykh Hisham: Yes Sayyidee.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: crap on them (laughing...)
Shaykh Hisham: Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar laughing

Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: That is what they need, Tawbah Astaghfirullah.
Shaykh Hisham: Sayyidee let Dr. Munir hear this, let him hear this "crap on them".
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Dr. Munir is here. Yes, let him hear it. MashaaAllah, Masha-Allah, laughing...
Shaykh Hisham: Mawlana, SubhaanAllah, this website, daily Sayyidee. It promotes Sufism, by using
Islamic Numerology. Like 786 and its meaning Bismillahi 'r-Rahman 'r-Raheem. All the names of the
Prophets we put them in numbers. Every name and letter have a number and the baraka of numbers in the
book of Imam Ghazali. Which he discussed and which other scholars also discussed.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: MashaaAllah MashaaAllah.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: How are the Salafi `Ulama?
Shaykh Hisham: Salafi `Ulama, half of them became Naqshbandi.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: laughing... Alhamdulillah.
Shaykh Hisham: Half became Naqshbandi, and the second half is waiting. They are confused what to do,
become Sufi or stay Salafi. They are thinking now.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Why they are thinking? No need to be Naqshbandi.
